info.title: zflip5-modem-module local API
info.description: Loopback-bound control API for a rooted Z Flip 5 used as a hotspot and modem. Remote browsers reach it only through `tailscale serve`. Writes that start radios are refused in an unsafe thermal state. The phone's own app is trusted by socket UID; Tailscale login and logout are app_only.

bearerAuth.description: Scoped bearer token. Scopes: `read-status` and `radio-control`. Tokens are 256-bit or longer, stored 0600 under `/data/adb`, and independently revocable. A caller from the `com.zflip5.modem` UID needs no token.

reason.description: Machine-readable token on every 409 and every app_only 403.

android_status.description: getCurrentThermalStatus(); advisory only, often NONE on Samsung.

temp_max_c.description: In /v1/status, temp_max_c is the median of the last 5 sysfs sweeps (25 s); temp_max_raw_c is the instantaneous value the gate used. /v1/thermal is always raw.

temp_max_raw_c.description: In /v1/status, temp_max_c is the median of the last 5 sysfs sweeps (25 s); temp_max_raw_c is the instantaneous value the gate used. /v1/thermal is always raw.

safe.description: PRIMARY gate: battery temp + /sys/class/thermal. Fails closed.

today_bytes.description: Mobile bytes used since local midnight today (device-local calendar date).

week_bytes.description: Mobile bytes used since the start of the current ISO week: Monday 00:00, device-local time.

month_bytes.description: Mobile bytes used since the 1st of the current calendar month, 00:00 device-local time.

today_human.description: today_bytes, formatted in SI decimal units (for example, "1.23 GB"). The *_bytes fields are always exact; *_human fields use 1 GB = 10^9 bytes, matching carrier data meters and Android's own data usage screen.

week_human.description: week_bytes, formatted the same way as today_human.

month_human.description: month_bytes, formatted the same way as today_human.

source.description: Counters are read from rmnet_data* in /proc/net/dev; a counter reset (reboot) is treated as a fresh delta, never negative.

period_bytes.description: Mobile bytes used since last_reset (manual or scheduled). A meter only — never used to gate the hotspot, radio, or CPU.

period_human.description: period_bytes, formatted the same way as today_human.

limit_bytes.description: Configured data cap in bytes. 0 = no limit configured.

reset_time.description: Device-local time of day the period resets, HH:MM.

reset_day.description: Day of month the period resets (monthly only).

last_reset.description: RFC3339 instant of the last reset (manual or scheduled), or "" if never reset.

next_reset.description: RFC3339 instant of the next scheduled reset, or "" for a manual period.

Status.description: Full device status. Prefer /v1/summary for polling.

per_client.description: Per-station rates, or "unavailable" while station counters do not move.

TailscaleStatus.description: Never carries a login URL, keys, or prefs.

dual_band.description: Persisted dual-band setting; `dual` is the live bridged AP.

slow_age_s.description: Seconds since the slow collector last ran. Clients treat a value above 30 as stale.

Forbidden.description: token lacks the required scope, or non-owner

Turn bench mode on or off (trips at 70 C instead of 48 C)

Set the data-cap limit and/or reset schedule (fields omitted from the body keep their current value)

limit_bytes.description: Bytes per period. 0 = no limit configured. Omit to keep the current limit; a limit-only edit never touches the period meter.

period.description: Reset cadence. weekly always resets Monday; manual never resets on its own.

reset_time.description: Device-local time of day the period resets, HH:MM.

reset_day.description: Day of month the period resets (monthly only).

200.description: full usage report with the updated quota

400.description: bad body, or an invalid period/reset_time/reset_day/limit_bytes value

500.description: config.json persist failed; the quota was NOT applied

post.summary: Manually reset the data-usage period now (period_bytes -> 0, last_reset -> now); today/week/month are untouched
Turn USB tethering on or off
